svg.title: mapkg: ask your map anything
svg.desc: Animated loop: a question is typed, an LLM writes a SPARQL query that is validated read-only, and a sonar ring sweeps the map revealing three cafes at 86, 305 and 756 metres.

g.text: nearest 86 m · SPARQL returned with the answer
OpenStreetMap as an RDF knowledge graph.
An LLM writes the SPARQL. Served over MCP.
Which cafes are within 1 km of NMIMS?
Every answer ships with the exact SPARQL that produced it.
